St. Petersburg Bicycle Club Saturday Ride

St. Petersburg, FL · North Shore · Road

St. Petersburg Bicycle Club Saturday Ride is a road group ride in St. Petersburg, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from North Shore Aquatic Center. About 20–25 miles, 16 / 18 / 20 / 22+ mph groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 16 / 18 / 20 / 22+ mph groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the St. Petersburg Bicycle Club Saturday Ride group ride

The club's main ride and the one it tells new people to start with. Pick a speed group at the pool and go north to Weedon Island or south to Pinellas Point. Slower groups are no-drop. No membership needed. Helmets required; no tri-bars in the group.
